rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is kept within limits or bounds.

example.english: This plan is constrained and cannot be expanded freely.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃受限制，唔可以隨意擴大。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 sau6 haan6 zai3 m4 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 ji3 kwok3 daai6

rows.note: Use this for a restrained, formal, or not-free style of writing or manner rather than a literal external limit.

example.english: They wrote the letter in a constrained style, without any colloquial language.
example.traditional: 佢寫封信寫得好拘謹，一啲口語都冇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 se2 fung1 seon3 se2 dak1 hou2 keoi1 gan2 jat1 di1 hau2 jyu5 dou1 mou5

rows.note: Use this when someone is forced or compelled to do something against their preference.

example.english: I was constrained to apologize even though I did not want to.
example.traditional: 我被逼住道歉，明明我唔想㗎。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bei6 bik1 zyu6 dou6 hip3 ming4 ming4 ngo5 m4 soeng2 gaa3
